integrity: Analytic proofs and reproducible finite computational comparisons; no independent audit or claim of exhaustive bibliographic novelty.
scientific_limitations: Positive-rate nearest-neighbor chains with exactly three states and fixed unit path metric only; no extension to longer paths or rate-scaled distances. Sharp fixed-stationary-law envelope is a nonattained supremum over strictly positive conductances. Historical synonym/index gaps remain possible.
title: Stationary-mass sharp Lipschitz amplification on three-state birth–death chains
